originalText: capture your next all-hands without a visible bot in the room so your Q&A stays candid
newText: capture your next all-hands with reliable notes — no meeting bot joins your calls; Granola runs on your Mac to help generate notes during and after your meetings. Let your team know you're taking notes.
readerTakeaway: A reader takes away that Granola's advantage is that participants won't see anything in the meeting, and that employees will speak more freely precisely because they aren't aware notes are being captured.
